fields.description: Record tag for the season/status table; opens the SRAM image.
fields.evidence: ASCII 'STAT' (bytes 53 54 41 54) at SRAM file offset 0x00000000 in baseline.sav; boot chain FUN_08000ab0 drives table setup through the CpuSet SWI 0xB bulk primitive FUN_08057d3c and the memset-like fill helper FUN_0804bf30.
fields.name: stat_magic

fields.description: Format version of the STAT record; 1 marks the checksummed 12-byte-header layout.
fields.evidence: u16 value 1 at SRAM file offset 0x00000004 in baseline.sav; the same version word reads 1 in the WSLU/LINE/SEAS/SERI/CARD/OPTS headers and 0 in the fixed BATT/PITC/WBAT/WPIT headers. Record-header parsing belongs to the save-table layer initialized under FUN_08000ab0 via FUN_08057d3c.
fields.name: stat_format_version

fields.description: Entry count of the STAT record; payload follows at file offset 0x0C.
fields.evidence: u16 value 1 at SRAM file offset 0x00000008 in baseline.sav, consistent with the 4-byte STAT payload at 0x0000000C. Table-dimension words of this kind are consumed by fixed-stride init loops of the FUN_08000680 form (N entries by 0x14-byte stride with FUN_08058950-derived fields).
fields.name: stat_entry_count

fields.description: Record tag for the batting-stats table (775 entries of 16 bytes).
fields.evidence: ASCII 'BATT' at SRAM file offset 0x00000010 in baseline.sav; chained geometry 0x0000001C + 775*16 = 0x0000308C lands exactly on the verified 'PITC' tag. Bulk table transfers use the FUN_08057d3c CpuSet primitive brought up by FUN_08000ab0.
fields.name: batt_magic

fields.description: Number of 16-byte batting-stat entries; covers file offsets 0x1C..0x308C.
fields.evidence: u16 value 775 (0x0307) at SRAM file offset 0x00000018 in baseline.sav; geometry chains exactly into the next record tag and the sum16_le batt_checksum verifies. Fixed-stride table init follows the FUN_08000680 loop pattern with FUN_08058950 software division.
fields.name: batt_record_count

fields.description: Number of 16-byte pitching-stat entries; covers file offsets 0x3098..0x4998.
fields.evidence: u16 value 400 (0x0190) at SRAM file offset 0x00003094 in baseline.sav; geometry chains exactly into the verified 'WBAT' tag at 0x00004998 and the sum16_le pitc_checksum verifies. Consumed by fixed-stride table loops of the FUN_08000680 form.
fields.name: pitc_record_count

fields.description: Number of 16-byte team-batting entries; covers file offsets 0x49A4..0x4CC4.
fields.evidence: u16 value 50 (0x32) at SRAM file offset 0x000049A0 in baseline.sav; geometry chains exactly into the verified 'WPIT' tag at 0x00004CC4 and the sum16_le wbat_checksum verifies. Fixed-stride table init per the FUN_08000680 loop pattern.
fields.name: wbat_record_count

fields.description: Number of 16-byte team-pitching entries; covers file offsets 0x4CD0..0x4FF0.
fields.evidence: u16 value 50 (0x32) at SRAM file offset 0x00004CCC in baseline.sav; geometry chains exactly into the verified 'WSLU' tag at 0x00004FF0 and the sum16_le wpit_checksum verifies. Fixed-stride table init per the FUN_08000680 loop pattern.
fields.name: wpit_record_count

fields.description: Byte length of the WSLU payload; covers file offsets 0x4FFC..0x51F0.
fields.evidence: u16 value 500 (0x01F4) at SRAM file offset 0x00004FF6 in baseline.sav; payload end 0x00004FFC + 500 = 0x000051F0 lands exactly on the verified 'LINE' tag, and the sum16_le wslu_checksum (0x063C) over this span verifies. Length-driven CpuSet transfers use FUN_08057d3c.
fields.name: wslu_payload_len

fields.description: Byte length of the LINE (lineup) payload; covers file offsets 0x51FC..0x723C and holds the nonzero 0/1/3-valued slot array.
fields.evidence: u16 value 8256 (0x2040) at SRAM file offset 0x000051F6 in baseline.sav; payload end lands exactly on the verified 'SEAS' tag at 0x0000723C, and the sum16_le line_checksum (0x739B) over this span verifies. Bulk-moved by the FUN_08057d3c CpuSet primitive.
fields.name: line_payload_len

fields.description: Byte length of the SEAS (season) payload; covers file offsets 0x7248..0x7CFC.
fields.evidence: u16 value 2740 (0x0AB4) at SRAM file offset 0x00007242 in baseline.sav; payload end lands exactly on the verified 'SERI' tag at 0x00007CFC, and the sum16_le seas_checksum (0x0BEB) over this span verifies. Bulk-moved by the FUN_08057d3c CpuSet primitive.
fields.name: seas_payload_len

fields.description: Record tag for the game-options block (16-byte payload).
fields.evidence: ASCII 'OPTS' at SRAM file offset 0x00007EB2 in baseline.sav; the trailing record of the image (payload 0x00007EBE..0x00007ECE, then 0xFF erased fill to end of SRAM). Option bytes are applied during the FUN_08000ab0 boot/bring-up sequence.
fields.name: opts_magic

fields.description: Packed general option word (observed 0x0101: both low bytes set to 1, e.g. enabled defaults).
fields.evidence: u16 value 0x0101 at SRAM file offset 0x00007EBE inside the OPTS payload in baseline.sav; covered by the verified sum16_le opts_checksum. Option application happens along the FUN_08000ab0 boot path; exact bit meanings are inferred, not decomp-confirmed.
fields.name: opts_setup_word

fields.description: Option toggle pair (observed 0x00FF: first byte 0xFF/selected, second 0x00).
fields.evidence: u16 value 0x00FF at SRAM file offset 0x00007EC2 inside the OPTS payload in baseline.sav; covered by the verified sum16_le opts_checksum. Semantics inferred from the 0xFF-selected/0x00 byte pattern; exact meaning not decomp-confirmed (save serializer outside the FUN_08000680..FUN_08058A98 decomp slice).
fields.name: opts_toggle_a

fields.evidence: u16 value 0x00FF at SRAM file offset 0x00007EC4 inside the OPTS payload in baseline.sav; covered by the verified sum16_le opts_checksum. Semantics inferred from the repeated toggle pattern; exact meaning not confirmed beyond the FUN_08000ab0 boot-option path.
fields.name: opts_toggle_b
